steps.title: Access Tags

audioNote.markdown:
Tags are flexible, granular keywords that help enhance session organization, filtering, and searchability. You can associate multiple tags with a single session.

Admins often use tags to track specific attributes—such as Sponsored Session, Live-Streamed, or On-Demand—to better manage how sessions are categorized and displayed within the platform.

To create a tag, click the orange Add Tag button.

steps.title: Statuses

audioNote.markdown:
Within the pop-up, complete all required fields. Status Name is the name of the status that will be visible internally and externally to session participants through the portal. 

Every status must be assigned a category. Once a category is selected, the new status will behave according to the rules of that category. For example, if you’re using a native integration, only sessions with a status categorized as “Accepted” will sync to the third-party site, as only accepted sessions are included in the integration.

Select the color of the status as it will appear within the dropdown list in the back-end. 

Order determines the sequence in which the status will appear within the Status field in the backend.
